verdict.rationale: Brex documents the inputs an audit trail would capture: policy rules applied to every transaction, multi-level approval routing, an audit agent that flags violations, and API-exposed records of which travel policy rules a booking violated. It also claims AI agents act with 'total transparency', but no evidence describes a per-expense log of edits and approvals. missing for 10: documented per-expense audit log/history of edits, recorded approval trail with approver identities and timestamps, export or retention of audit records for external auditors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
